items.title: Property investors targeted in 'ambitious' budget
items.description: Treasurer Jim Chalmers has defended negative gearing and capital gains tax changes unveiled in his fifth federal budget last night. Follow live.

items.title: How Australians across generations feel about the budget
items.description: Australians across generations, from gen Z to baby boomers, weigh in on the "intergenerational equity" budget.

items.title: Breaking a promise on negative gearing is a calculated risk
items.description: If the reforms help younger Australians believe home ownership is within reach, Labor can expect to collect a political dividend.

items.title: Live: ASX lower in first session after budget, US inflation spikes to 3.8pc
items.description: As the nation digests the budget, Australian shares are trading lower, with the ASX 200 down after a mixed night on Wall Street, with US inflation rising to 3.8 per cent. Follow our live markets blog.

items.title: Live: Trump labels critical news reports on Iran 'virtual treason'
items.description: US President Donald Trump says he does not need help from Beijing to end the war with Iran but says he will talk at length with Chinese President Xi Jinping when they hold a summit this week. Follow live.

items.title: Iran war becomes a 'double-edged sword' for China as Trump visits
items.description: As US President Donald Trump prepares to meet his Chinese counterpart in Beijing, some analysts say the war in Iran has significantly shifted the power dynamics in China's favour.

items.title: Coronial inquest into death of tasered 95yo Clare Nowland begins
items.description: Three years after the great-grandmother was tasered by a police officer in her aged care home, an inquest is expected to focus on dementia training for aged care staff and emergency services.

items.title: Plan for Trump Tower on Gold Coast scrapped as brand labelled 'toxic'
items.description: The branded tower proposed for Surfers Paradise would have been Australia's tallest building.

items.title: Eurovision pays musical homage to Austria-Australia confusion
items.description: The first semifinal of the Eurovision Song Contest included a comedic musical interlude about the differences between Austria and Australia, and sent 10 countries through to the grand final on Saturday.

items.title: 'An absolute victory': Good character evidence scrapped in NSW
items.description: A survivor advocate behind the campaign calling for good character references to be abolished in sentencing perpetrators of sexual offences has described the NSW reform as "an absolute victory".

items.title: British paratroopers drop onto remote island after suspected hantavirus case
items.description: The UK has ordered 10 people from remote island territories go into isolation, while parachuting in medical supplies, clinicians over suspected hantavirus case.

items.title: Australian-born MP at centre of 'palace coup' plot to knife British PM
items.description: Up until the past few days, Catherine West kept a low profile, as far as politicians go. Most Brits would never have come across the Australian-born, London-based MP before, but that all changed at the weekend.

items.title: NT government reveals scope of review into child protection system
items.description: The NT government has revealed the scope of a review into the territory's child protection system, and announced that it will be led by retired NSW police commissioner Karen Webb and long-standing territory public servant Greg Shanahan.

items.title: E-scooter rider dies after being hit by car while crossing Perth highway
items.description: A man in his 40s is struck by a hatchback and killed while riding an e-scooter across Reid Highway in Perth's northern suburbs.

items.title: Wil Anderson hates advertising. So why does he host a show about it?
items.description: It's been 18 years of hosting Gruen for Wil Anderson, but the self-confessed advertising cynic says the topic is more relevant than ever.

items.title: The pianist fighting the MSO over right to bring whole self to stage
items.description: In 2024, Jayson Gillham's show was cancelled for his on-stage comments about Palestine. Now he brings a legal suit and a new recital tour with a Palestinian Jordanian artist.

items.title: How Broadbeach became a blues mecca
items.description: As some festivals crumble, the Gold Coast's mayor says the 25-year-old Blues On Broadbeach event isn't going anywhere.

items.title: How fuel prices have impacted car sales
items.description: Electric vehicles now represent 16 per cent of new car sales in Australia, in a growing trend coinciding with record fuel prices.

items.title: Federal budget includes $50 million to duplicate Belconnen road
items.description: Other funding boosts for the ACT revealed in the budget papers include $50 million to duplicate Drake Brockman Drive in West Belconnen, aimed at servicing the area's growing population, and almost $10 million for the National Film and Sound Archive.

items.title: Farmers and environmentalists label federal budget 'savage' and 'tragic'
items.description: Weed and pest control programs have been cut in the federal budget as farmers and conservationists grapple with feral animals and noxious plants.

items.title: Emergency department nurse faces deportation due to son's condition
items.description: A Victorian emergency department nurse and her family face deportation before the end of the month due to her six-year-old son's developmental delay.

items.title: Solar eclipse to attract thousands to 'middle of nowhere' in 2028
items.description: One of the longest solar eclipses this century, albeit for five minutes, is set to put the remote East Kimberley on the world map.

items.title: Voss says Carlton in a better place than when he took charge
items.description: Michael Voss has struck a defiant tone after leaving Carlton, insistent the AFL club is in better shape than when he started as coach.

items.title: Australia axes quick as Women's T20 World Cup squad is named
items.description: Brisbane Heat left-arm pace bowler Lucy Hamilton has been selected in Australia's T20 World Cup squad with the experienced Darcie Brown a surprise omission.

items.title: Police attend 160 family violence call-outs in Melbourne's south in one week
items.description: Police say a man who threatened to kill his wife with a hammer and tried to set fire to a property was just one of dozens of arrests for family violence in a single week in the Dandenong area.
